findings.name: Gradient text
findings.description: Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text.

findings.name: AI color palette
findings.description: Purple/violet gradients and cyan-on-dark are the most recognizable tells of AI-generated UIs. A gradient in one of those hues is the tell on its own; flat neon ink on a dark ground is charged once a second tell hue joins it. Choose a distinctive, intentional palette.
